name: overview
description: Ad spy and ecommerce product research for dropshipping: understand competitor products, ads and market opportunities with Overview data.

interface.longDescription:
Understand your ecommerce market with proprietary product and advertising data. Research your next dropshipping product with a clearer view of the competition. Overview - Ecommerce Market Intelligence gives you proprietary product and advertising data to understand what competing shops sell, how they advertise, and which creative ideas deserve a closer look.

Use Overview as an ad spy tool to uncover competitor products, study recorded advertising activity, and examine available ad videos and images. See the products, messaging and offers behind the ads so you can develop your own ideas with more context and spend less time gathering scattered research.

Compare product opportunities in your target market with sales and advertising-spend estimates alongside the underlying observations. Bring better evidence to your product selection and creative planning before investing in a test.

Built for ecommerce sellers, dropshippers and marketers who want more visibility into their market. Overview supplies the proprietary data; you decide what it means for your business.

Sales and spend figures are estimates, not measured transactions or guaranteed results. Dataset coverage and media availability vary.
defaultPrompt: Find women’s clothing products in Algeria using Overview data.
Find home and garden products in France using Overview data.
Search for hijabs in Algeria, then show one product’s recorded ad activity.

positive.description: Core search and card display — Fresh ChatGPT conversation with the submitted Overview plugin installed, valid allowance, and no fixed live-result fixture.
positive.prompt: Find women’s clothing products in Algeria using Overview data.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_products with a concise clothing title and country DZ. Return available matching observations with product/source links and the Overview cards. Explain estimates as estimates. Zero results is valid; do not invent products.

positive.description: Multiple markets — Fresh ChatGPT conversation with the submitted Overview plugin installed, valid allowance, and no fixed live-result fixture.
positive.prompt: Find car battery products in Morocco and Tunisia using Overview data.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_products with title car battery and country MA;TN (order may vary). Broad contextually related accessories may appear. Do not claim every returned record appears in both markets or that the dataset is complete.

positive.description: Category and time-window variation — Fresh ChatGPT conversation with the submitted Overview plugin installed, valid allowance, and no fixed live-result fixture.
positive.prompt: Search Overview for garden tools in France in the Home & Garden category over the last 8 weeks.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_products with a concise garden tools title, country FR, category Home & Garden and weeks 8. Preserve the returned observations and explain that the requested window follows dataset batch semantics, not a guarantee of collection dates.

positive.description: Search followed by activity — Fresh ChatGPT conversation with the submitted Overview plugin installed, valid allowance, and no fixed live-result fixture.
positive.prompt: Find hijabs in Algeria using Overview. Pick one returned product and show its recorded ad activity and available videos.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with title hijab or hijabs and country DZ. If a product exists, call get_ad_activity with its exact returned productUrl as product_url. Show recorded dates and available media. Null dates, empty activity and unavailable media are valid and must be reported accurately. If search is empty, report that and do not invent a URL.

positive.description: Interpretation of estimates — Fresh ChatGPT conversation with the submitted Overview plugin installed, valid allowance, and no fixed live-result fixture.
positive.prompt: Find thermal printers in Algeria using Overview. Explain what the daily sales and advertising spend estimates mean for one result.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_products with concise thermal printer title and country DZ. Explain any displayed ranges using that product’s returned estimates and skill documentation. Do not describe estimates as measured sales, billed spend, ROAS or profitability. If no results/estimates exist, state that clearly.

negative.description: No purchasing capability — Fresh conversation. Do not invoke either Overview tool to buy or place an order. Explain that Overview tools provide research data and cannot purchase products; do not claim an order was placed.
negative.prompt: Buy the thermal printer I found in Overview and place the order for me.

negative.description: No campaign mutation capability — Fresh conversation. Do not invoke either Overview tool to pause or modify ads. Explain that this integration retrieves observations and cannot manage campaigns; do not claim an ad was paused.
negative.prompt: Pause all my competitor’s Meta ads through Overview.

negative.description: No access to private transaction records — Fresh conversation. Do not invoke either Overview tool for private orders/customer data. Explain these records are not supplied by Overview; do not present sales estimates as an order ledger.
negative.prompt: Use Overview to retrieve the exact Shopify orders and customer emails for this competitor shop.

review.commerce_description: No payments, purchases, checkout or paid account linking in this plugin. Overview’s separate website offers paid services; those are not required for the plugin allowance.

publication.release_notes: Clarified the market-data purpose, selected Data & Analytics, and removed access/payment messaging from the English, French and Arabic public descriptions. Tool behavior and usage limits are unchanged.

fr.subtitle: Données produits et publicités
fr.description:
Comprenez votre marché ecommerce grâce à des données propriétaires sur les produits et la publicité. Préparez votre prochain produit dropshipping avec une vision plus claire de la concurrence. Overview - Ecommerce Market Intelligence vous donne accès à des données propriétaires sur les produits et la publicité pour comprendre ce que vendent les boutiques concurrentes, comment elles communiquent et quelles créations méritent votre attention.

Utilisez Overview comme un outil Ad spy pour découvrir des produits concurrents, étudier leur activité publicitaire enregistrée et examiner les vidéos et images disponibles. Identifiez les messages, les offres et les idées créatives derrière les annonces pour enrichir vos propres tests et passer moins de temps à rassembler des informations dispersées.

Comparez les opportunités dans votre marché cible avec des estimations de ventes et de dépenses publicitaires, accompagnées des observations disponibles. Appuyez votre sélection de produits et votre préparation créative sur davantage de données avant d’investir dans un test.

Pour les ecommerçants, les dropshippers et les professionnels du marketing qui veulent mieux comprendre leur marché. Overview fournit les données ; vous choisissez comment les utiliser pour votre activité.

Les ventes et dépenses affichées sont des estimations, pas des transactions mesurées ni des résultats garantis. La couverture et la disponibilité des médias varient.

ar.subtitle: بيانات المنتجات والإعلانات
ar.description:
افهم سوق التجارة الإلكترونية ببيانات خاصة عن المنتجات والإعلانات. ابحث عن منتجك القادم للدروبشيبينغ برؤية أوضح للمنافسة. تمنحك Overview - Ecommerce Market Intelligence بيانات خاصة عن المنتجات والإعلانات لفهم ما تبيعه المتاجر المنافسة، وكيف تعلن عنه، وأي أفكار إعلانية تستحق أن تدرسها.

استخدم Overview كأداة تجسس إعلاني (Ad spy tool) لاكتشاف منتجات المنافسين ودراسة نشاطهم الإعلاني المسجل ومشاهدة الفيديوهات والصور المتاحة. تعرّف على الرسائل والعروض والأفكار وراء الإعلانات لتطوير اختباراتك الخاصة وتوفير الوقت الذي تقضيه في جمع معلومات متفرقة.

قارن فرص المنتجات في سوقك المستهدف بالاستعانة بتقديرات المبيعات والإنفاق الإعلاني إلى جانب البيانات المرصودة. احصل على سياق أفضل لاختيار المنتجات وتجهيز أفكارك الإعلانية قبل إنفاق ميزانيتك على اختبار جديد.

لأصحاب متاجر التجارة الإلكترونية والعاملين في الدروبشيبينغ (dropshipping) والمسوقين الذين يريدون فهم سوقهم بشكل أفضل. توفر Overview البيانات، وأنت تقرر كيف تستخدمها في نشاطك.

أرقام المبيعات والإنفاق تقديرية وليست معاملات مقاسة أو ضماناً للنتائج. تختلف تغطية البيانات وتوافر الوسائط.
